info.title: Alazab Daftra workflow
info.description: Derived from supplied API export; tenant and runtime validation required.

get.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of records for a workflow-type entity. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

Workflow-type entities are configurable record types (for example maintenance orders or service requests). The `workflow_id` path segment selects the workflow type, and the resource prefix plus that id form the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`. Each record is a work-order-based row belonging to that type. The available fields — including any custom fields — are defined by the selected workflow type's configuration, so the record shape varies between workflow types; custom fields are returned under the `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data` object.

The trailing path segment is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page number or a response-format extension. Pagination is controlled by the `page` and `per_page` query parameters; results can be narrowed with `filter[...]`, ordered with `sort[...]`, and trimmed with `fields`.

Filter and sort act on the record's **own columns**. The fields below are an example for a maintenance-order workflow — the exact set is workflow-specific. Custom-data fields (returned under `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data`) are **not** filterable or sortable through this endpoint.

**Filterable fields (example).** `filter[<field>]=<value>` (exact) or `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>`:

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `number` | string | `filter[number][like]=000` |
| `title` | string | `filter[title][like]=order` |
| `start_date` | date | `filter[start_date][greater_than_equal]=2026-01-01` |
| `client_id` | integer | `filter[client_id][equal]=5` |

(`filter[status]` is currently ineffective for this entity, and a `search` query parameter has no effect — use `filter[...]`.)

**Sorting.** Sort with `sort[<field>]=asc|desc` (e.g. `sort[number]=desc`) on the record's columns. The scalar `sort=field` / `sort=-field` form is not supported (HTTP 400), and no default order is guaranteed — always pass `sort[...]` for stable ordering.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The id of the workflow type whose records to list. Combined with the resource prefix this forms the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to `20`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter on the record's own columns, as `filter[<field>]=<value>` (exact) or `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>` (e.g. `filter[number][like]=000`). Only records matching all filters are returned. Custom-data fields are **not** filterable through this endpoint (see the endpoint description).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by a field using the bracket form `sort[<field>]=asc|desc` (e.g. `sort[number]=desc`). The scalar form `sort=field` / `sort=-field` is not supported and returns HTTP 400. No default ordering is guaranteed — pass `sort[...]` for a stable order.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each returned record.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Set to `2` to return each record through the display formatter — notably file/media fields (e.g. staff photos) come back as fully-qualified URLs. The response keys are otherwise unchanged.

200.description: Paginated list of the workflow type's records.

400.description: Returned when the request cannot be processed (invalid parameter, entity not found, or the Workflow plugin is not active for the account).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid. A permission denial (valid token, no access) instead returns `401` with an `error` field.

get.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single workflow-type-entity record by id. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The `workflow_id` path segment selects the workflow type (entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`); `record_id` is the record to fetch. The successful response is a **flat object** of the record's fields — it is not wrapped in a `data` envelope. The available fields depend on the workflow type's configuration; custom fields are returned under both the `custom_data` alias and the `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data` object.

The trailing path segment is the **data level** (how deeply related records are loaded); it is inert for a single-record fetch and is not a response-format extension.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The id of the workflow type. Combined with the resource prefix this forms the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`.

200.description: The workflow record as a flat object (not wrapped in a data envelope).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid. A permission denial (valid token, no access) instead returns `401` with an `error` field.

500.description: Returned when the record cannot be loaded, including when the record id does not exist. The body is the plain text `error happened` (not JSON).

post.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a record in a workflow-type entity. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The `workflow_id` path segment selects the workflow type (entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`); the new record is a work-order-based row stamped with that type. The request body is a **flat object** whose keys are the workflow type's fields. The standard fields are listed below; custom fields for the workflow type are supplied under the `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data` object.

**Required fields are defined by the selected workflow type** and enforced server-side; when a required field is missing the response is `422` with an `errors` map naming each field. For example, workflow type 1 (Maintenance Orders) requires `number.code`, `start_date`, and `budget.currency`. The record number itself is assigned by the server (submit only `number.code`).

On success the `message` is localized to the workflow type's name, e.g. `"<name> Added Successfully"`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The id of the workflow type into which the record is created. Combined with the resource prefix this forms the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`.

generated.description: leave empty, the system will assign its value

number.description: Auto-numbering fieldset. Provide `number.code` (the numbering-scheme code); the sequential number is assigned by the server, so leave `number.generated` empty. Whether this field is required depends on the workflow type's configuration.

assigned_users.description: Ids of staff assigned to this record.

budget.description: Budget as a Currency fieldset: `number` (amount) and `currency` (ISO code). Whether `budget.currency` is required depends on the workflow type's configuration.

branch_id.description: Branch id. Defaults to the request branch when omitted.

staff_id.description: the staff member who added this instance

le_workflow-type-entity-{{workflow_id}}_.description: Per-workflow custom fields for this workflow type, keyed by field name. The available custom fields are defined by the workflow type's configuration.

200.description: Record created. `message` is localized to the workflow type's name; `id` is the new record id.

400.description: The record could not be saved. Two cases: the Workflow plugin is not active for the account → `{"message":"Plugin is not installed"}`; or a save error → `{"message":"Entity not saved","error":"<detail>"}`.

e.description: Diagnostic details of the failure (present on save errors).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

422.description: Validation failed. `errors` lists the fields the workflow type requires or rejects.

errors.description: Map of field name to an array of validation messages. Field names use dot notation for nested fieldsets (e.g. `number.code`, `budget.currency`).

put.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates a record in a workflow-type entity. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. Both `PUT` and `POST` to this path are accepted.

The `workflow_id` path segment selects the workflow type (entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`) and `record_id` identifies the record. The request body is a **flat object** whose keys are the workflow type's fields and **must include `id` matching `record_id`**. Custom fields are supplied under the `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data` object (include its existing row `id` to update in place).

**Required fields are defined by the selected workflow type** and enforced server-side; a missing required field returns `400` with an `errors` map (note: unlike create, which returns `422`). On success the `message` is localized to the workflow type's name, e.g. `"<name> Updated Successfully"`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The id of the workflow type. Combined with the resource prefix this forms the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`.

id.description: The id of the record to update. Must match the `record_id` in the URL.

number.description: Auto-numbering fieldset. Provide `number.code` (the numbering-scheme code) only if changing it. Required only when the workflow type requires it.

budget.description: Budget as a Currency fieldset (`number`, `currency`). Required per the workflow type's configuration.

le_workflow-type-entity-{{workflow_id}}_.description: Per-workflow custom fields to update. Include the existing custom-data row `id` to update it in place; the available fields are defined by the workflow type.

200.description: Record updated. `message` is localized to the workflow type's name; `id` is the record id.

400.description: The update could not be completed. Cases: record not found → `{"message":"Record not found"}`; validation failure → `{"message":"Entity not saved","errors":{...}}`; save error → `{"message":"Entity not saved","error":"<detail>"}`; or a permission denial → `{"message":"<reason>"}`.

errors.description: Present on validation failure: map of field name to validation messages (dot notation for nested fieldsets).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

404.description: The record could not be loaded for update.
